changelog:
- Initial release of the humanizer skill.
- Transforms AI-generated text to sound more natural and human-written.
- Supports access to 50+ models for image, video, speech, music, chat, web search, and document processing via a single API.
- Includes instructions and examples for using SkillBoss’s multi-provider AI API with one key.
- Covers endpoints for chat, image generation, video, TTS, STT, music, document parsing, search, email, SMS, and smart model selection.
